decision_scope: APPROVE_OR_REVISE_ONLY_THE_3000_SLOT_PT_EN_ESPERANTO_MASTER_SEMANTIC_LEXICON_ARCHITECTURE; DO_NOT_GENERATE_THE_3000_ENTRIES CREATE_NEW_HNK_FORMS REGISTER_WAVE04 PROMOTE_AUTHORITY OR ALTER_L03_WITH_THIS_APPROVAL

governance_decisions.proposal: Preserve the approved 30-domain and A1/A2/B1/B2 allocation totaling exactly 3000 semantic slots.
Treat each slot as one governed concept rather than forcing one orthographic word per language; allow natural multiword equivalents and explicit unresolved mappings.
Use English as an international semantic pivot and Esperanto as a semantic/morphological reference, never as authorities that select HNK forms, meanings, etymologies or productive morphology.
For Esperanto store lemma/reference form, root or base, morphology, lexicalization type and verification status so transparent derivations and compounds are distinguished from independent roots.
Map existing HNK recovered/authored/selected forms onto semantic slots only after sense review; never force a mapping or reinterpret a HNK form from external-language resemblance.
Build the master in 30 auditable batches of 100 concepts with global indices 0001..3000; each batch requires semantic duplicate and ambiguity review before completion.
Keep Wave05+ HNK form generation paused until the semantic master and Euphony+ERR contracts are attached; preserve the independent Wave04 registration gate exactly as pending.

approval_rule: A future SIGA in this semantic-master thread may approve only DEC-HNK3000-PTEO-ARCH-001 through DEC-HNK3000-PTEO-ARCH-008 if this gate remains materially unchanged. The same approval must not generate Batch 01 entries, create HNK forms, register Wave04, promote authority, approve B16 or alter L03.
